name: Fireman Wilf, Bottle Oven Legend

intro.text: Fifty years firing ovens. I know when a kiln's ready by the colour of the flame and the smell of the smoke. I know when a trainer's ready the same way. Let's find out about you.

win: You're fired, duck. In the good way. Properly fired, glazed and ready for the world.
after: When the last oven went cold, I cried. Then I put the kettle on. That's the Potteries for you.
